input.prompt: Photo shot on an iPhone, candid everyday snapshot taken by a family member from the doorway of a child's bedroom at dusk. A grandmother in her mid-sixties with a silver bob and a grey cardigan sits on the edge of a small toddler bed reading a picture book, while a three-year-old girl in yellow pyjamas hugs a worn grey plush rabbit beside her. Lit by a bedside lamp and the last daylight from the window. Pale blue walls, a laundry basket and a few toys on the floor, a folded blanket. Slightly off-centre framing, natural colours, a little digital grain and soft focus from the phone. The book cover has no legible text. No studio lighting, no professional camera look.

Photo shot on an iPhone, candid everyday snapshot taken from above while standing at a kitchen table. A woman's hands, wearing a rolled-up denim shirt sleeve and a thin silver bracelet, place a single handwritten sheet of paper on a light wooden table next to a mug of tea and a set of house keys. The sheet shows blue-pen handwriting with exactly this text: "Bedtime: 1. Song 2. Teeth 3. Rabbit". Morning light from a nearby window, a slightly crooked framing, a child's crayon drawing without legible text in the background, a bit of crumbs and everyday clutter on the table. Natural colours and a little phone-camera grain. No studio lighting, no professional camera look.

Photo shot on an iPhone, candid everyday snapshot taken by a partner from the living room. A Latino father in his early thirties, wearing a grey t-shirt and sweatpants, crouches in a family hallway at bedtime and plugs a small star-shaped nightlight into a wall socket. Seen from behind and in profile. A child's bedroom door is half open with a warm strip of light and a plush rabbit on the pillow inside. A ceiling light is on, a row of kids' shoes sits under a coat rack. Slightly tilted framing, natural indoor light mixed with the warm hallway light, a little phone-camera grain. No legible text. No studio lighting, no professional camera look.

Photo shot on an iPhone, candid everyday snapshot taken by someone standing nearby in a bright family kitchen. A white father in his mid-thirties with a short beard, in a rumpled blue button shirt, holds a toddler on one hip and a single sheet of paper at arm's length, squinting at two handwritten black-marker lines that read exactly: "Her usual routine" and "The thing that calms her down". The toddler tugs at his collar. A cereal bowl, a sippy cup and a plush rabbit sit on the counter. Morning sunlight through a window with sheer curtains, slightly off-centre framing, natural colours, a little phone-camera grain. Do not add any signature, watermark or mark in the corners. No studio lighting, no professional camera look.

Photo shot on an iPhone, candid everyday snapshot taken from above at the dinner table. A child's plate with pasta and peas sits next to a blue placemat with a small plastic fork and a cup of milk. A woman's hand with a plain wedding band holds a small white index card propped against a milk jug. The card has large, clearly legible handwriting reading exactly: "Rabbit: the grey one with the torn ear. Song: Twinkle Twinkle." A grey plush rabbit with a torn ear sits on a chair beside the plate. A warm kitchen pendant light overhead, a dark window reflection behind, slightly tilted framing, natural colours, a little phone-camera grain. No studio lighting, no professional camera look.
